_comment: What Mission Control's Español report (Reports > Español) shows for La selva: each scored
Puerta's point, the Spanish prompt, the picture options and the right answer. Copied from the
story page; the story never reads this file (Presentar en clase reads it for the right answer).
Every Puerta is one picture tap, so each has one blank with key null, and each option's index
is the choice event's choiceIndex (the order the page shows them: A, B, C). The fork is never
scored. scripts/check-modules.js fails the build if a scored Puerta has no entry here.
focus: Hearing singular vs. plural, color words that agree, and numbers (tres vs. trece)

puertas.label: las ranas means more than one
puertas.prompt: Marisol: “¡Shhh! Miren… las ranas. ¿Dónde están las ranas?”
puertas.ask: Tap the picture that shows what she means.

options.text: One frog on a leaf (una rana)
Two frogs on a rock (dos ranas)

puertas.label: la mariposa azul: one, and the color agrees
puertas.prompt: Marisol: “¡Qué bonito! Toma una foto de la mariposa azul.”

options.text: One gray-brown butterfly with eye spots (una mariposa gris y café)

puertas.label: tres (3) vs. trece (13)
puertas.prompt: El cuidador: “Tranquilo. Dale tres pedazos de papaya.”
puertas.ask: Tap the plate you'll give him.

options.text: A plate with 3 pieces of papaya (tres pedazos)
A plate with 13 pieces of papaya (trece pedazos)
A plate with 2 pieces of papaya (dos pedazos)

puertas.label: dos ranas y un tucán: every word agrees on how many
puertas.prompt: La profe Daniela: “A ver… ¿en qué foto hay dos ranas y un tucán?”
puertas.ask: Tap the photo on your phone.

options.text: Two frogs and one toucan (dos ranas y un tucán)
One frog and two toucans (una rana y dos tucanes)
Two frogs and two toucans (dos ranas y dos tucanes)
